thread:
zoe: Heads-up: noticed consistent undercount in billing vs preview for routes tagged 'nlp-search' after the rollout of the new routing-policies service last night. Small but persistent.

rahul: I saw a ticket. Quick check: routing-policies v1.8 changed route resolution precedence; some edge routes now resolve to a fallback that has sample_rate=0.1. That seems wrong.

mike: Do we have an example tenant id to repro?

zoe: Tenant t-4421 shows production tokens 1.2M for window, preview 12M. Same timeframe.

claire: That indicates ingestion is being sampled. The change was intended only for downstream analytics. Where does the sample_rate live? In the policy proto. We accidentally toggled 'enforce_sampling_on_ingest' to true in the default.

jen: Rollback options: revert policy default, or patch ingest to ignore policy.sample fields until we ship a safe rollout. Which is faster?

rahul: Revert the deploy is fastest. I've queued rollback rpol-20260401 -> prev config.

ops-bot: rollback triggered: rpol-20260401 by rahul at 2026-04-01T02:15Z.

mike: While rollback proceeds, we should prevent automated billing adjustments. Mark any auto-reconciliation jobs to pause for affected time window.

billing-bot: Pausing auto-reconciliation for window 2026-04-01T00:00 -> 2026-04-01T03:00 for routes matching 'nlp-search'.

claire: Backfill strategy: replay raw-kafka topic 'ingest-raw' from offsets covering impacted window, filter by route patterns, reingest to preview with tag backfill=replay. Validate diffs for a sample tenant set before promoting to prod replay.

jen: Important: reingest must carry the original request_id to allow dedupe. Our dedupe service uses (tenant, request_id) with TTL 72h. If original events lacked request_id because sampling stripped headers, we need another plan.

zoe: I saw ~0.05% of events without request_id correlated with certain proxies. But majority still have request_id. We can reconcile those with session_id + timestamp heuristics as last resort.

rahul: Also add console telemetry: per-route token gap metric (production vs preview) and a visual flag when gap > 10% for 15m. This should have caught it earlier.

ops-bot: Creating issue BILL-10201: "routing-policies sampling applied to ingest -> backfill + telemetry" assigned to rahul, mike.

mike: I'll schedule the preview-replay tonight in a low-traffic window. Will share runbook and sample tenant diff link.

zoe: CS notice draft: "We identified a temporary sampling configuration that affected usage collection for a subset of routes. We're replaying events and will reconcile invoices. No action required from customers." Please review.

claire: Long-term fix: 1) add stronger config validation in policy compiler to prevent sample fields from being applied to ingest unless explicit; 2) Console lens showing sampling scope (metrics vs ingest vs preview); 3) alert on prod vs preview token deltas per route.

jen: I'll add a unit test in policy-compiler and a runtime guard that logs and drops any policy that attempts to set ingest sampling without explicit opt-in.

(1hr later)
rahul: Rollback completed. prod token rate returned to expected within ~3 minutes. Preparing preview replay job.

mike: Preview-replay started on holdout tenants. Will post diffs when done.

zoe: Thanks team. Let's schedule a 30m retro tomorrow to walk through rollout guardrails and console telemetry scope. Closing thread."
